title: Murder Onboard
summary: Camille's friend, a singer on a boat, is found poisoned during her last performance.
method: The killer put poison in the shot glass that the victim drank from and hid the evidence afterwards. His reflection was visible in photos taken by guests.
motive: The victim discovered that the killer was transporting drugs to places where the party boat went and blackmailed him for money.
notes: Richard tries to be nice to Camille, as she just lost her friend. The friend is supposed to be Camille's school friend but her age is stated as 23.
